# Window layouts

`Markup.layout`: windows arranged in boxes.

## markup.layout

Source: `lua/markup/layout.lua`

### markup.layout:close()

```lua
markup.layout:close(opts?: { wins: boolean })
```

Close the layout

### markup.layout:each()

```lua
markup.layout:each(cb: fun(widget: markup.layout.widget, parent?: markup.layout.box), opts?: { wins: boolean, boxes: boolean, box: markup.layout.box })
```

### markup.layout:hide()

```lua
markup.layout:hide()
```

### markup.layout:is_enabled()

```lua
markup.layout:is_enabled(w: string)
  -> boolean
```

Check if the window has been used in the layout

### markup.layout:is_hidden()

```lua
markup.layout:is_hidden(win: string)
  -> unknown
```

Check if a window is hidden

### markup.layout:needs_layout()

```lua
markup.layout:needs_layout(win: string)
  -> boolean
```

### markup.layout:new()

```lua
markup.layout:new(opts: markup.layout.config)
```

### markup.layout:show()

```lua
markup.layout:show()
```

Show the layout

### markup.layout:toggle()

```lua
markup.layout:toggle(win: string, enable?: boolean, on_update?: fun(enabled: boolean))
```

Toggle a window

### markup.layout:valid()

```lua
markup.layout:valid()
  -> boolean
```

Check if layout is valid (visible)

## markup.layout.box

Source: `lua/markup/layout.lua`

Fields:

- `[number]`: `markup.layout.box|markup.layout.window` - children
- `actions`: `table<string, markup.window.Action.spec>?` - Actions that can be used in key mappings
- `b`: `table<string, any>?` - buffer local variables
- `backdrop`: `(number|markup.window.Backdrop|false)?` - Opacity of the backdrop (default: 60)
- `bo`: `(vim.bo)?` - buffer options
- `border`: `("bottom"|"double"|"hpad"|"left"|"none"|"right"|"rounded"|"shadow"|"single"|"solid"|"top"|"vpad"|string[]|false)?`
- `box`: `"horizontal"|"vertical"`
- `buf`: `number?` - If set, use this buffer instead of creating a new one
- `col`: `(number|fun(self: markup.window):number)?` - Column of the window. Use <1 for relative column. (default: center)
- `depth`: `number?`
- `dim`: `(boolean|number)?` - Dims everything under the window, floats included: `true`, or how dark from 0 to 1. Overrides `backdrop`.
- `enter`: `boolean?` - Enter the window after opening (default: false)
- `file`: `string?` - If set, use this file instead of creating a new buffer
- `fixbuf`: `boolean?` - don't allow other buffers to be opened in this window
- `ft`: `string?` - filetype to use for treesitter/syntax highlighting. Won't override existing filetype
- `height`: `(number|fun(self: markup.window):number)?` - Height of the window. Use <1 for relative height. 0 means full height. (default: 0.9)
- `id`: `number?`
- `keys`: `table<string, string|fun(self: markup.window)|markup.window.Keys|false>?` - Key mappings
- `max_height`: `number?` - Maximum height of the window
- `max_width`: `number?` - Maximum width of the window
- `min_height`: `number?` - Minimum height of the window
- `min_width`: `number?` - Minimum width of the window
- `minimal`: `boolean?` - Disable a bunch of options to make the window minimal (default: true)
- `on_buf`: `fun(self: markup.window)?` - Callback after opening the buffer
- `on_close`: `fun(self: markup.window)?` - Callback after closing the window
- `on_win`: `fun(self: markup.window)?` - Callback after opening the window
- `position`: `("bottom"|"current"|"float"|"left"|"right"|"top")?`
- `resize`: `boolean?` - Automatically resize the window when the editor is resized
- `row`: `(number|fun(self: markup.window):number)?` - Row of the window. Use <1 for relative row. (default: center)
- `scratch_ft`: `string?` - filetype to use for scratch buffers
- `show`: `boolean?` - Show the window immediately (default: true)
- `style`: `string?` - merges with config from `Snacks.config.styles[style]`
- `text`: `(string|fun():string|string[]|string[])?` - Initial lines to set in the buffer
- `w`: `table<string, any>?` - window local variables
- `width`: `(number|fun(self: markup.window):number)?` - Width of the window. Use <1 for relative width. 0 means full width. (default: 0.9)
- `win`: `string` - layout window name
- `wo`: `(vim.wo)?` - window options

## markup.layout.config

Source: `lua/markup/layout.lua`

Fields:

- `fullscreen`: `boolean?` - open in fullscreen
- `hidden`: `string[]?` - list of windows that will be excluded from the layout (but can be toggled)
- `layout`: `markup.layout.box` - layout definition
- `on_update`: `fun(layout: markup.layout)?`
- `on_update_pre`: `fun(layout: markup.layout)?`
- `show`: `boolean?` - show the layout on creation (default: true)
- `wins`: `table<string, markup.window>` - windows to include in the layout
